landing.title: Morobot — Smart web process automation
landing.description: Morobot designs, records, and runs browser workflows — visual automation powered by Excel data sources.
landing.lead: Design repetitive browser workflows once, feed them with Excel data, and run them again with a single click.
landing.featuresTitle: From record to run, one pipeline
landing.featuresSub: No heavy coding — visual editor, data sources, and browser extensions.
landing.featuresImgAlt: Recording, data, and playback in Morobot
landing.featRecordBody: Capture clicks and inputs in the browser and turn them into a process graph.
landing.featEditorBody: Drag groups, actions, and loops on the canvas and fine-tune the logic.
landing.featDataBody: Attach spreadsheets to a process; cells update live while it runs.
landing.featPlayBody: Run with the Player extension on real tabs; control delays and errors.
landing.howSub: From idea to stable runs — a short path.
landing.how1Body: Build on the canvas manually or capture the path with Recorder.
landing.how2Body: Add an Excel file as a source and map columns to fields.
landing.how3Body: Start from the process list and watch live table results.
landing.stackSub: Three companion extensions for record, play, and pick.
landing.extRecorderBody: Capture user interaction and build the initial graph.
landing.extPlayerBody: Stable playback of processes on real pages.
landing.extSelectorBody: Precise element picking for selector mapping.
landing.ctaBandBody: Open the panel, create a process, and try automation today.

panel.processesSub: Processes are stored in the browser (no server yet).
panel.extModalDesc: To record a process, install Morobot Recorder once with Load unpacked. The player extension is separate and not required for recording.
panel.extStep2: Turn on Developer mode (if it is off).
panel.extStep3: Load unpacked → select the path above.
panel.extNote: Each extension (record / play) has its own path and is loaded once; portal sync keeps it updated.
panel.extMissing: The recorder extension is required to record.
panel.extStillMissing: Recorder extension still not found — Load unpacked with the recorder path.
panel.extPlayerDesc: To run, stop, or pause a process, install the Morobot Player extension once with Load unpacked. If you only need to record, you do not need the player.
panel.extPlayerMissing: The player extension is required to run or stop.
panel.extPlayerStillMissing: Player extension still not found — Load unpacked with the player path.
panel.extSelectorDesc: To copy element selectors with right-click, install Morobot Selector once with Load unpacked.
panel.extSelectorMissing: Selector extension is not installed — required for the editor workflow.
panel.extSelectorStillMissing: Selector extension still not found — Load unpacked with the selector path.
panel.extSmartDesc: To smart-learn a process, install Morobot Smart Recorder once with Load unpacked. Interactions are sent to the server as contexts.
panel.extSmartMissing: Smart Recorder is required for smart learning.
panel.extSmartStillMissing: Smart Recorder still not found — Load unpacked with the smart path.
panel.extPathCopied: Path copied — paste/select it in Load unpacked.
panel.extPathCopyFail: Copy failed; copy the path from the box above manually.
